message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by winning rounds. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck works best with 2–8). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”), plus 4 “Wild” and 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile. Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card from your hand that matches either the color or the value of the top discard card. You may also play a Wild or Wild Draw Four at any time. | | **Action Cards** | • **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction (acts like Skip if only two players).
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can be challenged if the player could have played a different card.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have one card left, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player calls you out, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands: numbered cards = face value, Draw Two/Skip/Reverse = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | | **Special Rules** | • **Challenge** – If a player plays a Wild Draw Four but could have played a matching color card, the next player may challenge. If the challenger wins, they draw four cards; if the challenger loses, they draw six.
• **Stacking** – Some house rules allow stacking Draw Twos or Draw Fours (e.g., if a Draw Two is played, the next player may play another Draw Two to pass the penalty).
• **Custom Decks** – Uno has many variants (Uno Attack, Uno Spin, etc.) with additional mechanics. | **Quick Tips** 1. Keep track of which colors are being played; try to hold onto a card that matches the current color to avoid drawing. 2. Use action cards strategically—save a “Reverse” for when you’re about to win to change the direction of play. 3. Watch opponents’ “UNO” calls; if you suspect they’re bluffing, consider challenging a Wild Draw Four. Enjoy the game!
